text: The owned CSS-removal patch deletes one accountSetup.css entry from files_changed in a fixture whose app_version is 128.0 and whose comm_head_rev names a historical release commit. Post-landing review says that historical path may be expected and requests re-addition only if an actual test fails. No such failure or taskgraph run is established. The fixed comparison fixture has later 153.0 revision/list metadata, so its changed contents do not validate the earlier fixture edit. Keep the source-file deletion, historical fixture identity and later fixture phase separate.
title: The import-style removal also edits a historical release-128 taskgraph fixture
